name: P2P — Flujo de Solicitud y Aceptación con WhatsApp

planSteps.description: Navigate to /registro. Fill out the form with name 'Donante QA', a randomly generated email address, and password 'Test1234!'. Remember this email as 'DonanteEmail'. Submit the form.
Select the 'Soy voluntario / particular' card, fill out the P2P onboarding form with alias 'donante-qa', phone '3001111111', and submit.
Navigate to /app/donaciones, click to publish a new offer, fill description 'Oferta Especial [TEST]', category 'alimentos', and save.
Navigate to /registro. Fill out the form with name 'Solicitante QA', a new randomly generated email address, and password 'Test1234!'. Remember this email as 'SolicitanteEmail'. Submit the form.
Select the 'Soy voluntario / particular' card, fill out the P2P onboarding form with alias 'solicitante-qa', phone '3002222222', and submit.
Navigate to /ofertas, find 'Oferta Especial [TEST]', and click the button to request it.
Verify a legal modal appears explaining the responsibility of the request
Accept the legal modal terms and submit the request with a message 'Necesito esta oferta de prueba'
Navigate to /login. Log in using the 'DonanteEmail' you remembered earlier and password 'Test1234!'.
Verify the request for 'Oferta Especial [TEST]' from 'solicitante-qa' appears in the list.
Navigate to /login. Log in using the 'SolicitanteEmail' you remembered earlier and password 'Test1234!'.
Verify the WhatsApp button with the donor's phone number is now visible.
